beats: After companion choice, ask the seller for Mother’s bottle.
Find his keys among the northern wood’s white flowers and return them.
Enter the unlocked shop to collect the already paid-for oil.
Bring the bottle to Mother, then measure oil, trim the wick and turn the great lamp’s brass wheel.
data.consequences: A full Key Items pocket delays collecting the keys; it does not make them disappear. The lamp lesson remains available around the pie visit.

description:
The oil errand connects the household to its forgetful neighbor and gives Mother a practical skill to pass on.

Only the great upstairs lamp is part of the lesson. No explanation of the lower lamp.
name: Learning the great lamp
